title: some / any / much / many / a few / a little

markup.[[x]]: 重点形式：这个语法要你注意的词（橙底）
markup.{x}: 变化的部分：只用在 [[ ]] 里，例如 work{s}（橙底里加粗下划线）
markup.((x)): 变回原形的动词（虚线下划线）
markup.~~x~~: 错句里错的部分（删除线）

idea.title: 一句话说清
idea.text: 这些小词都在回答「**有多少**」。先看后面的东西能不能数：能数的用 many、a few，不能数的用 much、a little；some、any、a lot of 两边都能用。

uses.zh: 能数的：多用 many，少用 a few
不能数的：多用 much，少用 a little

some-any.title: some 和 any
some-any.rule: 说「有一些」用 some；否定句和问句里用 any。**请别人吃喝、请别人帮忙时，问句也用 some**，因为你希望对方说 yes。

examples.en: We've got [[some]] time before the demo.
examples.zh: 演示前我们还有点时间。

many-much.title: many 和 much
many-much.rule: many 跟能数的，much 跟不能数的。much 多用在否定句和问句里；肯定句说「很多」，口语一般说 **a lot of**。

examples.en: We had [[a lot of]] feedback on the new design.
examples.zh: 新设计收到了很多反馈。

few-little.title: a few 和 a little
few-little.rule: a few 跟能数的，a little 跟不能数的，意思是「**有一些，够用**」。去掉 a，变成 few、little，意思就成了「**太少了，几乎没有**」。

items.zh: 今天做完的可能性不大。

part-all.title: 全部、大部分、一个都没有
part-all.rule: 说「一群里面的多少」，用 **all / most / some / none + of the（或 of my、of us）**。泛泛地说，不指哪一群，就不要 of the。

items.en: [[Most of]] my colleagues live near the office.
items.zh: 我的同事大多住在公司附近。

items.en: [[Some of]] the screens look odd in dark mode.
items.zh: 有些页面在深色模式下看着怪怪的。
我们没有一个人知道密码。

notes: 泛泛地说不加 of the：[[Most]] people like holidays.（大多数人）· [[Most of the]] people here are engineers.（这里的大多数人）
两个都用 both：[[Both of]] the designs are good.

commonMistakes.why: milk 不能数，用 a little。
泛泛地说「大多数人」，不加 of。
a lot 后面跟名词要加 of。

quiz.prompt: 哪个词后面能数的、不能数的都能跟？
quiz.explain: [[a lot of]] 两边都能用：a lot of bugs · a lot of time。
请别人喝东西，希望对方说 yes，用 [[some]]。

quiz.prompt: 改成否定句：We've got some time.
accept: We have not got any time.
We do not have any time.

traps.note: 否定句里 some 要换成 any。

quiz.prompt: 改错：How much bugs did you fix today?
quiz.answer: How many bugs did you fix today?

quiz.prompt: We don't have ___ time before the demo.
Can I have ___ milk in my tea?
quiz.explain: milk 不能数，「一点」用 [[a little]]。

quiz.prompt: I've got ___ ideas. Shall we talk?
quiz.explain: ideas 能数，「有几个，挺好」用 [[a few]]。

accept: I have got a few questions.

quiz.prompt: ___ of the tests passed. Not one failed.
quiz.explain: 一个都没失败，就是「全部」：[[All of]] the tests。
泛泛地说「大多数人」，不加 of：[[Most]] people。

quiz.prompt: ___ of us knew the password, so we had to reset it.
改错：I don't have some money with me.
quiz.answer: I don't have any money with me.
accept: I haven't got any money with me.
I do not have any money with me.

quiz.prompt: 改错：We have a lot bugs this week.
quiz.answer: We have a lot of bugs this week.
accept: We've got a lot of bugs this week.
We have lots of bugs this week.
quiz.explain: a lot 后面跟名词要加 of：[[a lot of]] bugs。

quiz.prompt: 改错：Most of people work from home on Fridays.
quiz.answer: Most people work from home on Fridays.
accept: Most of the people work from home on Fridays.
quiz.explain: 泛泛地说，不加 of：[[Most]] people。

openTask.prompt: 用 3 句话说说你们团队现在的情况，比如人、时间、bug、反馈。至少用到 many / much 里的一个，a few / a little 里的一个，和一个 some / any。
rules: many / a few 跟可数名词，much / a little 跟不可数名词
否定句和一般疑问句用 any，肯定句用 some
most / all / none 后面接具体一群时要加 of the / of my
openTask.note: 规则判数量词和名词是否搭配（计分）；离线模型给更自然的说法（AI 建议，不计分）
